name: Spring Signature Lux
description: Premium pocket spring mattress offering balanced support, airflow channels, and plush quilting for luxury sleep.

faqs.question: Is this mattress good for couples?
faqs.answer: Yes, the pocket spring layers reduce motion transfer for uninterrupted sleep.

faqs.question: Does this support hot sleepers?
faqs.answer: The ventilated design improves airflow and keeps the sleep surface cooler.
